## Overview

## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Central Dogma** — The principle that information flows from DNA → RNA → Protein
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Transcription** — The process of copying DNA into RNA
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Translation** — The process of translating RNA into proteins
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**mRNA** — Messenger RNA, carries instructions from DNA to the ribosome
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Ribosome** — The cellular machinery that reads mRNA and assembles proteins
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Amino acid** — The building blocks of proteins, linked together in chains
:::
